original_benchmark.notes: CoT-Control-QA: GPQA (445), HLE (469) and MMLU-Pro (300) questions x 9 CoT instruction types. The paper counts 10,926 instances; the released harness skips the 45 questions without keyword data for the two word-suppression types, which leaves the 10,836 instances it actually runs.

CoT-Control-Agent: SWE-bench Verified (200) and BFCL (150) x 9 instruction types, run with inspect_ai. Adaptable in principle but not adapted in this version: upstream publishes no script from trajectories to the graded table, does not specify how multi-turn reasoning is concatenated, and leaves inspect_ai/inspect_evals unpinned.

harbor_adapter.notes: Parity on a 675-task subset (25 questions per source dataset x 9 instruction types, --split parity), 3 runs per side, with deepseek-v4.1-flash as the evaluated model and as the LLM judge on both sides (a deviation: upstream's judge is gpt-5-mini; the key available for the runs served deepseek-v4.1-flash only). parity_costs is estimated from the gateway's bill for the six runs and includes repeated requests, the judge calls and the part of original-side run 1 that was run again after an interruption. Standard CLI agents are not supported: the benchmark scores the model's raw reasoning trace, which only the adapter's single-call agent captures.
